newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips to sell minor units, focus on core.
newsitem.headline: Philips to sell minor units, focus on core.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Friday it would sell nine of its smaller operating companies before the end of this year allowing it to focus on growing its core activities.
"Philips Industrial Electronics (IE)...announced its intention to further stimulate growth in several of its operating companies," the Dutch electronics giant said in a statement.
"This decision, which will allow the division to focus on and strengthen its key businesses, will also lead to nine smaller operating companies being sold," it said.
It said the companies concerned accounted for around 15 percent of IE divisional sales. "The transactions are planned to take place before year-end," it added.

The firms to be divested are: Philips Power Systems of Wavre, Belgium; Thermocoax of Suresnes, France; Philips TV Test Equipment of Brondby, Denmark; Philips Weighing and Philips Electronic Center of Hamburg, Germany; Philips Industrial Automation Systemems of Eindhoven and PBF of Almelo; Philips Kistaindustrier AB of Kista, Sweden and Edax International of Mahwah, New Jersey, USA.

Philips' IE division would focus on several clusters of activities, such as analytical equipment, communication and security products and systems, electronic production equipment and industrial and infrastructure projects, it said.
